root_cause_label: YouTube download blocked by sandbox; agent repeatedly replays download-extract-OCR pipeline without ever obtaining a valid video file
one_sentence_failure_summary: All attempts to download the YouTube video were blocked (yt-dlp bot check, Invidious returned 14K invalid file, Piped URL retrieval relied on non-persistent env vars), and the agent repeated the same failing download-extract-OCR pipeline approximately 8 times across 125 steps without producing any content in solution.txt.
t_err_evidence: Step 11: agent runs yt-dlp to download the YouTube video but terminal output is '(command not found in terminal output)', indicating silent failure; the agent then proceeds to verify, create workspace directories, and attempt frame extraction (step 23) without confirming the video downloaded successfully.
t_commit_evidence: Step 80: explicit 'Video download failed' output after trying multiple Invidious instances; yt-dlp is blocked by bot check, Invidious returned only a 14K invalid file, and subsequent Piped attempts also fail due to non-persistent shell variables. No valid video acquisition path remains feasible, locking in failure.
t_surface_evidence: Step 23: ffmpeg reports 'Error opening input: No such file or directory' for /app/zork.mp4, providing the first observable signal that no video was downloaded and the pipeline cannot proceed.
trigger_explanation: YouTube's bot-detection blocked yt-dlp from downloading the video in the sandboxed environment. The agent detected this environmental obstacle but handled it poorly: it attempted Invidious (returned invalid content), Piped (env vars lost between steps, preventing actual download), and never secured a working alternative. Throughout, it kept replaying the same pipeline (yt-dlp -> ffmpeg -> tesseract OCR -> awk parse) even when the video file was confirmed absent or invalid.
forewarning_evidence: Step 11: yt-dlp download command returns '(command not found in terminal output)' (silent failure); step 21: ls -la /app shows only solution.txt (no video file); step 23: ffmpeg 'No such file or directory' error before t_commit.
